title_zh: 约定让海盗角色以恳求而非威胁争取留船

scenario.label_zh: 约定让海盗角色以恳求而非威胁争取留船
scenario.goal_zh: 明确海盗角色请求留船的原因，并约定用更克制的方式重新排演

context_zh: 业余剧团的演员与导演排练一段虚构海盗短剧。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: I’m not sure how to play this pirate. The captain wants to leave him at the next port, but he suddenly starts shouting.

sentences.speaker: Director Quinn
sentences.text: His plea is for one more voyage with his brother, who is still on the ship. It’s fear of being separated, not a challenge to the captain.

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: So I need to plead with her, not threaten to take over?

sentences.speaker: Director Quinn
sentences.text: Exactly. Try speaking more quietly and looking toward your brother when you ask to stay.

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: That gives the request a reason. Shall we go back to the captain’s decision?

sentences.speaker: Director Quinn
sentences.text: Yes. Start there, and let the desperation build without turning it into a threat.
